subjectQuote:
CITY OF CAÑON CITY ISSUE 2A: CONTINUED
COLLECTION OF TEMPORARY SALES AND
USE TAX FOR CONSTRUCTION AND
OPERATIONS OF A COMMUNITY POOL.

whatItDoes:
WITHOUT RAISING TAXES, SHALL THE EXISTING 0.3%
TEMPORARY SALES AND USE TAX TO SUPPORT
FINANCING OF THE CONSTRUCTION OF A COMMUNITY
RECREATION POOL AND RELATED POOL CAPITAL
IMPROVEMENTS BY THE CAÑON CITY AREA
METROPOLITAN RECREATION AND PARK DISTRICT
(THE "RECREATION DISTRICT") BE AMENDED TO
PERMIT SUCH TAX TO ALSO BE USED FOR
OPERATIONS AND MAINTENANCE OF THE COMMUNITY
RECREATION POOL FACILITY AND RELATED POOL
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENTS WHICH ARE OPERATED BY
THE RECREATION DISTRICT; AS PREVIOUSLY
APPROVED SHALL THE SALES AND USE TAX ONLY BE
COLLECTED UNTIL DECEMBER 31, 2050; SHALL THE
CITY BE PERMITTED TO RETAIN ALL REVENUES
PREVIOUSLY COLLECTED FROM THE TAX FOR THE
PURPOSES HEREIN; SHALL THE CITY BE AUTHORIZED
TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE
RECREATION DISTRICT CREATING FINANCIAL
OBLIGATIONS EXTENDING BEYOND THE CURRENT
FISCAL YEAR TO PAY THE PLEDGED REVENUES,
INCLUDING THOSE REVENUES PREVIOUSLY
COLLECTED, TO THE RECREATION DISTRICT; AND
SHALL THESE PLEDGED REVENUES BE COLLECTED,
RETAINED, AND SPENT AS A VOTER APPROVED
REVENUE CHANGE OF THE CITY NOTWITHSTANDING
ANY REVENUE LIMITS PROVIDED BY LAW?

subjectQuote:
CAÑON CITY SCHOOL DISTRICT RE-1 ISSUE
4A: MILL LEVY OVERRIDE EXTENSION

whatItDoes:
WITHOUT INCREASING TAXES, SHALL SCHOOL
DISTRICT FREMONT RE-1 (CAÑON CITY SCHOOLS)
EXTEND TAXES APPROVED BY THE DISTRICT’S
VOTERS IN 2017 AND WHICH ARE SCHEDULED TO
EXPIRE, TO CONTINUE TO PROVIDE FUNDS USED IN
ALL DISTRICT SCHOOLS, INCLUDING MOUNTAIN
VIEW CORE KNOWLEDGE SCHOOL, TO:
ENHANCE EDUCATIONAL OPPORTUNITIES FOR
·
CAÑON CITY PRESCHOOLERS;
SUSTAIN STUDENT ACCESS TO MODERN
·
TECHNOLOGY;
INVEST IN COMPREHENSIVE SCHOOL SAFETY
·
IMPROVEMENTS;
ATTRACT AND RETAIN QUALITY TEACHERS
·
AND STAFF; AND
PREPARE STUDENTS FOR SUCCESS AFTER
·
GRADUATION BY PROVIDING CAREER
TRAINING, INTERNSHIPS, AND
OPPORTUNITIES TO EARN COLLEGE CREDIT
AND INDUSTRY CREDENTIALS.
THROUGH AN ONGOING PROPERTY TAX OVERRIDE
MILL LEVY IMPOSED AT A RATE SUFFICIENT TO
CONTINUE FUNDING $1,385,000 ANNUALLY FOR
DEPOSIT INTO THE DISTRICT’S GENERAL FUND AND
TO BE IN ADDITION TO THE PROPERTY TAXES THAT
OTHERWISE WOULD BE LEVIED FOR THE GENERAL
FUND?

subjectQuote:
DEER MOUNTAIN FIRE PROTECTION DISTRICT
ISSUE 6A: TAX INCREASE FOR FIRE
PROTECTION AND RELATED SERVICES

whatItDoes:
SHALL DEER MOUNTAIN FIRE PROTECTION DISTRICT
TAXES BE INCREASED BY $361,851 IN 2026 FOR
COLLECTION IN 2027, AND ANNUALLY THEREAFTER BY
THE IMPOSITION OF AN ADDITIONAL MILL LEVY OF NOT
MORE THAN 6.9 MILLS, WITH SUCH PROCEEDS TO BE
USED FOR CAPITAL AND GENERAL FUND PURPOSES
OF THE DISTRICT INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO:
MAINTAINING VOLUNTEER RECRUITMENT AND
·
INCREASING FIREFIGHTER AND EMT
AVAILABILITY LEVELS TO SAFELY AND
EFFICIENTLY RESPOND TO EMERGENCIES;
PROVIDE FUNDING FOR FIRE AND EMERGENCY
·
MEDICAL SERVICES PROVIDED BY THE DISTRICT;
PROVIDE FUNDING FOR THE REPLACEMENT OF
·
AGING APPARATUS FLEET THROUGH A PHASED
PATHWAY TO BRING THE FLEET INTO
ALIGNMENT WITH CURRENT RELIABILITY,
SAFETY AND RESPONSE READINESS
EXPECTATIONS;
AND ANY FUNDS EXPENDED PURSUANT TO THIS
QUESTION SHALL BE SUBJECT TO STATE LAWS,
REGULATIONS AND DISTRICT POLICIES FOR
ACCOUNTABILITY AND TRANSPARENCY; AND SHALL
SUCH TAX INCREASE BE AN ADDITIONAL PROPERTY
TAX MILL LEVY IN EXCESS OF THE LEVY AUTHORIZED
FOR THE DISTRICT, PURSUANT TO AND IN
ACCORDANCE WITH SECTION 29-1-301, C.R.S.; AND
SHALL THE DISTRICT BE AUTHORIZED TO COLLECT,
RETAIN AND SPEND ALL REVENUES FROM SUCH
TAXES AND THE EARNINGS FROM THE INVESTMENT
OF SUCH REVENUES AS A VOTER APPROVED
REVENUE CHANGE UNDER ARTICLE X, SECTION 20 OF
THE COLORADO CONSTITUTION AND ANY OTHER LAW?
